covers: JSE close and rand on Wednesday 18 November 2026, plus the first 90 minutes of Wall Street trade to 18:02 SAST; compared with Tuesday's closes in the Midday update
headline: JSE All Share falls 3.7% and the rand weakens to R17.24/$; miners and banks lead the slide
summary: The JSE All Share fell 3.7% to 106,572 and the Top 40 3.9% to 98,733 on Wednesday, with miners down 5%-7% and the big banks down about 4%, while the rand weakened to R17.24 per dollar by 18:02 SAST from R16.76 on Friday (LRC Market Dashboard, 18 Nov 2026). On Wall Street, the S&P 500 was 0.3% lower at 7,316 and the Nasdaq 0.2% higher at 24,375 at 18:02 SAST, with Nvidia down 1.9% at $152.57 after its after-hours gain on Tuesday faded. Gold fell to $3,754 an ounce, platinum to $1,361 and Brent to $89.44, a day before the SARB decision with the repo rate at 7.25%.

items.title: JSE All Share down 3.7%, Top 40 down 3.9% in a broad sell-off
items.summary: The All Share ended Wednesday at 106,571.70 against Tuesday's 110,616.44 (-3.7%) and is 5.2% below Friday's 112,387.90. The Top 40 ended at 98,732.67 against 102,752.15 (-3.9%). The fall came on the day October CPI rose to 5.2% and as gold, platinum and copper fell. Large losers included Harmony (-7.2%), Sibanye-Stillwater (-7.2%), AngloGold Ashanti (-6.8%), Anglo American (-6.0%), Capitec (-6.0%), Naspers (-5.8%), Impala Platinum (-5.9%), Gold Fields (-5.5%) and Absa (-6.1%); Standard Bank fell 4.1% and FirstRand 3.7%.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), J203/J200 and JSE share quotes, 18 Nov 2026 17:00-17:15 SAST; Tuesday close 17 Nov 2026; Friday close 13 Nov 2026

items.title: S&P 500 -0.3% at 7,316, Nasdaq +0.2% at 24,375 early in the session
items.summary: At 18:02 SAST the S&P 500 was at 7,316.21 against Tuesday's close of 7,340.53 (-0.3%) and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,375.29 against 24,328.38 (+0.2%). Both remain about 3% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27). Chip stocks were mixed: Broadcom +3.7% and AMD +1.2%, Micron -1.6%. UnitedHealth was down 6.4%.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), quotes at 18:02 SAST, 18 Nov 2026; Tuesday close 17 Nov 2026; Friday close 13 Nov 2026

items.title: US 10-year yield eases to 5.07%
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield was 5.07% at 18:02 SAST, against 5.103% at Tuesday's close and 5.154% on Friday. The October FOMC minutes are due later on Wednesday.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), ^TNX at 18:02 SAST, 18 Nov 2026; closes 17 and 13 Nov 2026

items.title: October CPI 5.2%, core 4.2%; SARB decides on Thursday
items.summary: Stats SA reported October inflation of 5.2% year on year (September 4.5%) and core inflation of 4.2% (September 4.0%). The SARB announces its decision on Thursday 19 November with the repo rate at 7.25% after September's 25bp hike; most economists polled before the release expected no change (Reuters).
items.source: Stats SA October 2026 CPI via LRC Macro Desk, 18 Nov 2026; Reuters via CNBC Africa, 18 Nov 2026

items.title: Banks and retailers fall with the market
items.summary: Among rate-sensitive shares, Capitec fell 6.0% to R4,468.10, Nedbank 4.6% to R271.48, Standard Bank 4.1% to R282.65 and FirstRand 3.7% to R88.89 on Wednesday, ahead of Thursday's rate decision.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), JSE quotes 18 Nov 2026 17:05-17:10 SAST

items.title: Rand at R17.24/$, weaker than the R17.07 reported at midday
items.summary: USD/ZAR was 17.2397 at 18:02 SAST, against R17.07 at 12:00 SAST (Bloomberg) and 16.7584 at Friday's close (-2.8% for the rand over the period). EUR/ZAR was 18.90 and GBP/ZAR 22.66.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance) ZAR=X, EURZAR=X, GBPZAR=X at 18:02 SAST, 18 Nov 2026; Friday close 13 Nov 2026; Bloomberg via BusinessTech, 18 Nov 2026

items.title: Gold $3,754 (-1.1%), platinum $1,361 (-3.5%), Brent $89.44 (-3.4%), copper -4.3%
items.summary: At 18:02 SAST gold futures were at $3,754.40 (Tuesday $3,797.00), platinum at $1,360.90 (Tuesday $1,410.00), Brent at $89.44 (Tuesday $92.57) and copper about $12,447/t (Tuesday about $13,001/t). Platinum is 8.6% and copper 7.1% below Friday's close. Weaker metal prices weigh directly on JSE gold, PGM and diversified miners.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance) GC=F, PL=F, BZ=F, HG=F at 18:02 SAST, 18 Nov 2026; closes 17 and 13 Nov 2026

items.title: Nvidia -1.9% at $152.57; after-hours gain from results has faded; our rating unchanged
items.summary: Nvidia traded at $152.57 at 18:02 SAST, 1.9% below Tuesday's close of $155.46, after trading at $161.90 after hours on Tuesday following results above estimates (revenue $115.8bn against $108.7bn consensus). Nvidia is on the LRC Investment watchlist (grade A, fair value $262.56); this note does not change the scanner rating.
items.source: LRC Market Dashboard (Yahoo Finance), NVDA at 18:02 SAST, 18 Nov 2026; NVIDIA Form 8-K, 17 Nov 2026; LRC Watchlist, 14 Nov 2026

items.title: Intuit -1.8%, Deckers +1.5%
items.summary: Intuit traded at $314.89 (-1.8%) and Deckers Outdoor at $82.69 (+1.5%) at 18:01 SAST. Both are on the LRC Investment watchlist (grade A, fair values $426.00 and $103.00); ratings unchanged.
